descriptionEn: Festival of lights celebrating abundance, joy, and the return of Lord Rama.

foodTraditions.significance: Feasting with rich slow-cooked dals, sweets, and sharing with neighbors and community.

descriptionEn: Nine sacred nights honoring Goddess Durga with fasting and pure sattvic foods.
descriptionNe: माँ दुर्गा की आराधना और नौ दिनों का सात्विक व्रत।

foodTraditions.fastingRules: Strict Phalahar: No onions, garlic, wheat, or lentils. Cook exclusively with Sendha Namak (rock salt), Kuttu, and Singhara.
foodTraditions.significance: Body detoxification and spiritual focus through seasonal transition.

descriptionEn: Harvest festival celebrating the sun transition and winter solstice across northern plains.
descriptionNe: सूर्य के मकर राशि में प्रवेश और फसल कटाई का उत्सव।

foodTraditions.significance: Celebration with fresh mustard greens, jaggery, sesame seeds, and winter harvest tubers.
